title: In Medias Res — Story Structure Explained
skills: identify stories that begin in the middle of the action
analyze how narrative openings affect pacing and suspense
evaluate how story structure shapes reader understanding
alignment_note: Explains in medias res as a narrative technique in which a story begins in the midst of the action. Supports analysis of plot structure, pacing, suspense, narrative sequencing, and authorial choices across high school English courses.
